name: cell_skin
desc:
cell_skin — the membrane between a Cell graph and the outside
world. MCP-native, audit-ready, replay-verifiable.

name: AllowAllSkinAuth
desc:
An auth implementation that accepts everyone — the explicit
anonymous opt-in for a loopback-only demo or test adapter.

name: BadArgumentsException
desc:
Thrown for a malformed wire argument envelope (positional keys that
are not a contiguous 0..n-1 range, or invalid named argument
identifiers). The router maps it to a bad_arguments WireError
before the target's apply ever runs.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: ContextBridge
desc: Translates a SkinPrincipal into a framework Context.

name: resolve
desc: The context for principal.

name: DescribeContextBridge
desc:
The default bridge: least privilege, provenance recorded in the
description.

name: resolve
desc: The context for principal.

name: JsonSchema
desc:
A small JSON Schema subset sufficient for MCP tools/list and REST
clients. Unknown keywords are preserved in extra.

name: JsonSchema.fromJson
desc:
Decodes a JsonSchema from its JSON form. Lenient where the spec
is richer than this subset: type may be an array (the first
entry wins) and additionalProperties may be a schema object
(treated as true).

name: permissive
desc: The permissive schema: accepts anything.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: McpAdapter
desc: The adapter lifecycle contract every MCP SDK adapter implements.

name: close
desc: Closes the server and releases the transport.

name: start
desc:
Registers the tool catalogue and subscriptions, then starts the
server.

name: McpResourceSpec
desc:
A transport-neutral MCP resource definition for the graph topology
(cell://graph/<cellId>) and the ledger stream.

name: McpToolSpec
desc:
A transport-neutral MCP tool definition, translated from a
SkinFunctionDescriptor. An SDK adapter maps these 1:1 onto
dart_mcp's Tool, mcp_dart's tool descriptors, or any other
SDK's equivalent.

name: name
desc: <cellId>.<functionName>.

name: RemoteCellClient
desc: A cell-shaped handle to one remote cell, backed by a transport.

name: RemoteCellClient.inProcess
desc: Creates the in-process variant over client.

name: call
desc:
Invokes function on the remote target and returns the target's
real outcome. Throws SkinError for exposure/cursor/argument
rejections; returns null for a pendingReceipt response.

name: cellId
desc: The remote graph name.

name: observe
desc:
State-change pulses for this cell (skin.egress.<cellId> carrying
WireStateChange).

name: observeStream
desc: Egress stream accessor for observe.

name: transport
desc:
The transport: submits a wire message and awaits the correlated
reply. SkinClient implements this in-process; a future
DartMcpAdapter-backed client implements it over JSON-RPC.

name: SchemaObserver
desc: Accumulates observed argument shapes per named argument into schemas.

name: namedSchemas
desc: The merged schema for observed named arguments.

name: observe
desc: Records one observed call.

name: positionalSchemas
desc: The merged schema for observed positional arguments, in order.

name: SkinAuth
desc: Authenticates transport credentials. Returns null to reject.

name: SkinBinding
desc: One exposed function on one target cell.

name: argumentSchema
desc:
Hand-written JSON Schema hint for MCP tools/list. Wins over
ledger-observed shapes; null falls back to observation then to
the permissive {} schema.

name: cellId
desc: The registered graph name of the target cell.

name: compensation
desc:
Optional compensation closure for ApplyCompensation. The
compensation receives the same wire arguments as the command, so
it knows what to undo.

name: compensationCell
desc: The cell the compensation targets; defaults to target.

name: description
desc:
Human-readable description for MCP tools/list; falls back to the
cell's description.

name: function
desc: The live Dart closure the command runs.

name: functionName
desc: The wire-facing function name.

name: strictCursor
desc:
Honour WireRequest.lastSeenSeq? Opt-in per binding: a cursor
conflict rejects with conflict before the target's apply runs.
A strict binding also rejects a request that omits the cursor
entirely (cursor_required).

name: target
desc: The live target cell, resolved at registration.

name: toApplyCommand
desc: Builds the framework ApplyCommand for a decoded WireRequest.

name: SkinBindingTable
desc: The (cellId, functionName) → closure lookup table.

name: all
desc: Every binding, flattened.

name: bindingsFor
desc: All bindings for cellId, in first-registration order.

name: exposedCellIds
desc: All exposed cell ids, in first-registration order.

name: exposesCell
desc: Whether any function is exposed for cellId.

name: isSealed
desc: Whether seal has been called.

name: length
desc: The number of registered bindings.

name: lookup
desc:
The binding for (cellId, functionName), or null when the
function was never exposed.

name: register
desc: Registers binding.

name: seal
desc: Freezes the table. Registrations after this throw StateError.

name: SkinCellDescriptor
desc: One exposed cell in the catalogue.

name: cellId
desc: The registered graph name.

name: description
desc: Human-readable description, when supplied.

name: functions
desc: The exposed functions, in binding-registration order.

name: SkinClient
desc: The in-process client over a SkinMembrane.

name: apply
desc:
Invokes (cellId, function) through the membrane and returns the
target's real ApplyOutcome.

name: events
desc: The full outbound pulse stream (responses, egress, ledger, errors).

name: ledger
desc: Ledger entries after since (inclusive of nothing older).

name: manifest
desc: Fetches the current tool catalogue.

name: observe
desc:
State-change pulses for one cell (skin.egress.<cellId> carrying
WireStateChange).

name: verify
desc: Verifies the membrane's ledger (requires a bound ledger).

name: SkinCredentials
desc: Transport-level credentials.

name: metadata
desc: Transport metadata (headers, peer address, …).

name: token
desc: Bearer token, when the transport carries one.

name: SkinError
desc: A wire-level failure surfaced to a skin client.

name: code
desc:
The stable error code (unknown_tool, conflict,
cursor_required, bad_arguments, closed, …).

name: message
desc: A human-readable description (never raw remote internals).

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: SkinFunctionDescriptor
desc: One exposed function in the catalogue.

name: argumentSchema
desc:
The advertised JSON Schema (binding hint, observed shape, or
permissive).

name: description
desc: Human-readable description, when the binding supplied one.

name: name
desc: The wire-facing function name.

name: strictCursor
desc: Whether callers must send a lastSeenSeq cursor.

name: SkinManifest
desc: The skin's discovery document: every exposed cell and function.

name: cells
desc: Exposed cells, in graph-registration order (roots first).

name: describe
desc: Builds the manifest from graph and bindings.

name: toolCount
desc: The total number of exposed functions.

name: SkinMembrane
desc: The four-Cell membrane between a CellGraph and the wire.

name: bindings
desc:
The exposure registry. Sealed at SkinMembrane.open — the egress
cells and the manifest can never diverge.

name: close
desc:
Closes the terminal cell, every egress observer, the receipt
join, the ledger-tail subscription and the response stream, and
fails every pending request() with a closed SkinError. The
graph and ledger stay open — they belong to the caller.

name: dispatcher
desc: The dispatch brain behind router.

name: egress
desc: Cell 3 — egress: one Cell.observe per exposed target.

name: graph
desc: The graph being skinned.

name: inbound
desc: Cell 1 — inbound: transport pulses enter here.

name: isExposed
desc:
Whether any function of cellId may cross the skin (binding and
whitelist policy combined).

name: ledger
desc: The graph's ledger, when one is bound.

name: manifest
desc: The current tool catalogue.

name: mux
desc: The fan-in primitive.

name: open
desc: Assembles the four cells over graph.

name: outbound
desc: Cell 4 — outbound: the terminal cell writing to the transport.

name: request
desc:
Emits one wire message into the inbound cell and awaits the
correlated response (a WireResponse, WireError or — for
manifest requests — a WireManifestResponse).

name: responses
desc:
The receipt join for egress pulses.
Every pulse that survives the mux, as a broadcast stream (router
responses, egress observations, ledger entries, errors).

name: router
desc: Cell 2 — router: binding lookup, cursor check, target.apply.

name: whitelist
desc: The declarative exposure policy, when configured.

name: SkinPrincipal
desc: The authenticated identity behind a request.

name: SkinPrincipal.anonymous
desc:
The unauthenticated principal used when no SkinAuth is
configured.

name: claims
desc: Free-form claims.

name: id
desc: Stable principal id.

name: roles
desc: Roles carried by the principal.

name: SkinPulseTypes
desc:
Pulse-type naming convention for the wire. Values follow the plan's
taxonomy; no new type system is introduced — these are Pulse.type
strings.

name: restResponseType
desc: rest.apply.response.{accepted,rejected,staged} for outcome.

name: resultType
desc: mcp.tools.result.{accepted,rejected,staged} for outcome.

name: SkinRouter
desc:
The dispatch brain behind the router cell. Testable without a live
cell, then materialised with SkinRouter.cell.

name: bindings
desc: The binding table (the exposure registry).

name: cell
desc: Materialises the router as a framework Cell.asyncMap.

name: descriptions
desc:
The receipt join for egress pulses.
Human-readable cell descriptions for the manifest.

name: graph
desc: The registered graph the router serves.

name: ledger
desc: The graph's ledger, when one is bound (cursor checks).

name: onApplied
desc: Optional observer for every dispatched outcome (tests, adapters).

name: route
desc: Routes one inbound wire pulse. Returns null to suppress.

name: whitelist
desc: The optional declarative exposure policy.

name: SkinWhitelist
desc: cellId → {functionName} exposure policy.

name: SkinWhitelist.new
desc: Creates a whitelist from cellId → functions entries.

name: allows
desc: Whether (cellId, functionName) may cross the skin.

name: cellIds
desc: All whitelisted cell ids.

name: empty
desc: A whitelist that exposes nothing.

name: functionsFor
desc: All whitelisted functions for cellId.

name: mentionsCell
desc: Whether the whitelist mentions cellId at all.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: SystemContextBridge
desc: A bridge that always returns Context.system.

name: resolve
desc: The context for principal.

name: WireError
desc:
An error that has no receipt: exposure-gate misses, transport
failures, and cursor conflicts.

name: WireError.fromJson
desc: Decodes a WireError encoded by toJson.

name: clientCorrelationId
desc:
The client-chosen correlation id, echoed verbatim when the
request carried one.

name: kind
desc: The stable discriminator used by WireMessage.fromJson.

name: toJson
desc:
JSON-serialisable wire form. Payloads stay JSON-safe; the pulse's
metadata travels on the pulse, not inside this map.

name: WireLedgerEntry
desc: A ledger entry streamed over the wire (skin.ledger.entry).

name: WireLedgerEntry.fromJson
desc: Decodes a WireLedgerEntry encoded by toJson.

name: kind
desc: The stable discriminator used by WireMessage.fromJson.

name: toJson
desc:
JSON-serialisable wire form. Payloads stay JSON-safe; the pulse's
metadata travels on the pulse, not inside this map.

name: WireManifestRequest
desc: Asks the membrane for its tool catalogue.

name: kind
desc: The stable discriminator used by WireMessage.fromJson.

name: toJson
desc:
JSON-serialisable wire form. Payloads stay JSON-safe; the pulse's
metadata travels on the pulse, not inside this map.

name: WireManifestResponse
desc: Carries the SkinManifest back to a discovery client.

name: WireManifestResponse.fromJson
desc: Decodes a WireManifestResponse encoded by toJson.

name: kind
desc: The stable discriminator used by WireMessage.fromJson.

name: toJson
desc:
JSON-serialisable wire form. Payloads stay JSON-safe; the pulse's
metadata travels on the pulse, not inside this map.

name: WireMessage
desc:
One wire event. Every transport — MCP, REST, SSE, stdio — is a
Pulse<WireMessage> whose type discriminates the variant.

name: WireMessage.fromJson
desc: Decodes a WireMessage produced by toJson.

name: kind
desc: The stable discriminator used by WireMessage.fromJson.

name: toJson
desc:
JSON-serialisable wire form. Payloads stay JSON-safe; the pulse's
metadata travels on the pulse, not inside this map.

name: WireNotification
desc: A fire-and-forget wire event (MCP notification, SSE ping, …).

name: WireNotification.fromJson
desc: Decodes a WireNotification encoded by toJson.

name: kind
desc: The stable discriminator used by WireMessage.fromJson.

name: toJson
desc:
JSON-serialisable wire form. Payloads stay JSON-safe; the pulse's
metadata travels on the pulse, not inside this map.

name: WireOutcome
desc:
The JSON read model of an ApplyOutcome: what the remote side can
know without the live graph.

name: argumentsOmitted
desc: Whether a receipt argument was replaced by a placeholder.

name: kind
desc: accepted, rejected, or staged.

name: reason
desc: The rejection reason, when the outcome was rejected.

name: reasonOmitted
desc: Whether reason was replaced by a placeholder during encoding.

name: receipt
desc: The receipt JSON (wire_receipt.dart shape).

name: result
desc: The result payload of an accepted outcome, when JSON-serialisable.

name: resultOmitted
desc: Whether result was replaced by a placeholder during encoding.

name: WirePulseGate
desc:
Rejects pulses whose payload is not a WireMessage (at either wrap
level — Cell.ingress<Pulse<WireMessage>> wraps the wire pulse in
the ingress's own pulse); allows every other channel.

name: action
desc:
Validates the execution of a functional action and its associated arguments
on the host cell, supporting Hybrid Convergence (Sync/Async).

name: call
desc:
The primary entry point for the Integrity Gate, executing the
validation pipeline for a specific object or state mutation.

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: link
desc:
Validates the establishment of a reactive link from a candidate Cell
to the host cell, supporting Hybrid Convergence (Sync/Async).

name: operator +
desc:
Composes this Integrity Gate (TestCell) with another validation rule
using the Compositional Algebra of the framework.

name: operator ==
desc: The equality operator.

name: pulse
desc:
Validates an incoming pulse intended for processing by the host cell,
supporting Hybrid Convergence (Sync/Async).

name: purity
desc:
A rule's purity. Defaults to Purity.pure; rules that perform
external I/O must override — a rule that reads external state (a
clock, an environment variable, a read-only database) to
Purity.readOnlyExternal, a rule that mutates external state (rare;
mostly misuse) to Purity.effectful and be journalled.

name: version
desc:
A rule's version. Defaults to '0.0.0'; subclasses should override
with a stable string. See Receptor.version.

name: WireReceipt
desc:
The read model of wireReceiptJson: what the remote side can know
without the live graph.

name: WireReceipt.fromJson
desc: Decodes a WireReceipt encoded by wireReceiptJson or toJson.

name: WireRequest
desc: An inbound call: invoke function on the cell named cellId.

name: WireRequest.fromJson
desc: Decodes a WireRequest encoded by toJson.

name: cellId
desc: The registered graph name of the target cell.

name: clientCorrelationId
desc:
The client-chosen correlation id, echoed back verbatim — matching
is never performed on this field.

name: correlationId
desc:
The server-assigned correlation id. SkinMembrane.request matches
responses on this id; transports generate it themselves and carry
the client-chosen id in clientCorrelationId, so a client can
never hijack another client's pending response.

name: function
desc: The exposed function name inside cellId's binding set.

name: kind
desc: The stable discriminator used by WireMessage.fromJson.

name: lastSeenSeq
desc:
Stateless-cursor field: the caller's last seen ledger sequence.
Required (non-null) for bindings that advertise strictCursor.

name: named
desc: JSON-decoded named arguments, or null when none were sent.

name: positional
desc: JSON-decoded positional arguments, or null when none were sent.

name: toJson
desc:
JSON-serialisable wire form. Payloads stay JSON-safe; the pulse's
metadata travels on the pulse, not inside this map.

name: WireResponse
desc:
An outbound result: the target's real ApplyOutcome, or — when the
ledger entry has not landed yet — a pending marker with the last
known receipt JSON.

name: WireResponse.fromJson
desc: Decodes a WireResponse encoded by toJson.

name: WireResponse.new
desc:
Invariant: a response is either pending, carries a live outcome,
or carries a decoded outcome JSON.

name: clientCorrelationId
desc:
The client-chosen correlation id, echoed verbatim when the
request carried one.

name: correlationId
desc: The correlation id echoed from the originating WireRequest.

name: kind
desc: The stable discriminator used by WireMessage.fromJson.

name: outcome
desc:
The target's own outcome. null only when pendingReceipt is
true (live) or when the response was decoded from JSON (a live
ApplyOutcome cannot be reconstructed without the live target
cell — outcomeJson carries the wire form instead).

name: outcomeJson
desc:
The wire outcome JSON for a decoded response; null for live
responses and for pending ones.

name: pendingReceipt
desc:
When true, outcome is null and receiptJson carries the last
known receipt (or is absent). The definitive receipt arrives via
the ledger stream (skin.ledger.entry).

name: receiptJson
desc:
Best-effort last-known receipt JSON while pendingReceipt is
true; null when no receipt has been seen for this cell at all.

name: toJson
desc:
JSON-serialisable wire form. Payloads stay JSON-safe; the pulse's
metadata travels on the pulse, not inside this map.

name: WireStateChange
desc: An outbound state observation: a target cell's value changed.

name: WireStateChange.fromJson
desc: Decodes a WireStateChange encoded by toJson.

name: cellId
desc: The registered graph name of the cell that changed.

name: kind
desc: The stable discriminator used by WireMessage.fromJson.

name: payload
desc:
The new state value, when JSON-serialisable (otherwise omitted —
the ledger entry carries the authoritative payload).

name: pendingReceipt
desc: Whether the ledger entry for this change has not landed yet.

name: receipt
desc:
The last known receipt for cellId, when the ledger has recorded
one. It may belong to an earlier change while pendingReceipt
is true; it is never fabricated.

name: toJson
desc:
JSON-serialisable wire form. Payloads stay JSON-safe; the pulse's
metadata travels on the pulse, not inside this map.

name: buildEgressCells
desc:
Builds the unledgered egress observers: one Cell.observe per
exposed target. Every pulse is pendingReceipt — without a ledger
there is no receipt to attach.

name: buildInboundCell
desc:
Builds the inbound transport cell from the framework's own
Cell.ingress.

name: buildMuxCell
desc:
Builds the mux: a Cell.synthesis over sources that passes the
wire pulse through and suppresses everything else.

name: buildOutboundCell
desc:
Builds the outbound terminal cell: a Cell.observe on mux whose
effect is send.

name: mcpResourceSpecs
desc: Resource specs for every exposed cell.

name: mcpToolSpecs
desc:
Translates a SkinManifest into neutral tool specs for MCP
tools/list.

name: mergeSchemas
desc:
Merges observed schemas by widening: the union of two shapes is the
looser of the two at every keyword. An absent constraint means
unconstrained — it never inherits the other side's constraint.

name: schemaForValue
desc: Derives a best-effort JsonSchema for a single observed value.

name: wireLedgerEntryCellId
desc:
The recorded cell id of entry — the value captured when the entry
was appended, immune to later registry resets.

name: wireLedgerEntryFromJson
desc: Decodes a ledger entry from its canonical JSON form.

name: wireLedgerEntryJson
desc: The canonical ledger JSON form — identical to LedgerEntry.toJson.

name: wireOutcomeFromJson
desc: Decodes the wire form into the WireOutcome read model.

name: wireOutcomeJson
desc:
Encodes a live ApplyOutcome to its wire JSON form, sanitising any
value JSON cannot encode (see WireOutcome.resultOmitted).

name: wireOutcomeKind
desc: The kind tag for outcome: accepted, rejected, or staged.

name: wireReceiptJson
desc: Encodes an ApplyReceipt to its wire JSON form.

name: wireStateChangeForEntry
desc:
Wraps one ledger entry as the authoritative skin.egress.<cellId>
state change: the entry's own receipt pairs with the entry's own
pulse payload. The receipt comes from the entry's canonical stored
JSON — the same encoding the audit trail itself uses.

name: cell_skin_api_chooser
desc: API Chooser — cell_skin

name: cell_skin_rest
desc: The REST binding entry point.

name: RestAdapter
desc: The HTTP + SSE adapter over a SkinMembrane.

name: activeSubscriptions
desc:
The number of live SSE subscriptions (observability for tests and
operations).

name: bind
desc: Binds the REST adapter on address:port (port 0 = ephemeral).

name: close
desc: Stops the server and all subscriptions.

name: port
desc: The bound port (after an ephemeral bind, this is the real port).

name: kDefaultMaxBodyBytes
desc: The maximum request body size accepted by default (1 MiB).
